findings.title: Später Onboardingfehler sperrt nächsten Start nicht dauerhaft
findings.observation: Enrollment-marker complete wird vor Upload/Enable/Start/Probe geschrieben; Fehler behält nur Lock, den kein Controller-Startgate auswertet.
findings.proposedVerification: Abbruch nach Enable/Start/HTTPS-Probe und nach Prozessverlust; anschließender Start muss durch durable fehlgeschlagene Onboardingphase verweigert werden.
findings.closureAssessment: Root-owned maintenance permit now binds coordinator PID/startTicks/bootID; controller ExecStartPre refuses incomplete operation or dead coordinator. Initial lock and removal fsync parent. Independent stop attempt occurs even when revoke fails; both failure cases tested.

componentFollowupFindings.title: SHIP Control/JSON frames can enter application callbacks outside data-channel trust gate
componentFollowupFindings.observation: Control and bare-JSON frames deliver SPINE-shaped content to application/CLS parser before trust or completed protocol selection, and outside the data channel even after completed handshake.
